product.olivetti-m290-20.summary: The compact M290 with two ISA slots on a riser.
product.olivetti-m290-20.history: Two surviving units are identified as the M290-20. One is reported to have been made in 1993 and the other has a BIOS dated to that year.
product.olivetti-m290-20.architecture: The riser fits expansion into the compact case. The photograph of the Clous unit shows two 16-bit ISA connectors.
product.olivetti-m290-20.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m290-20.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m290-20.ports: The specimen’s diagnostic identifies the ports. CheckIt 2.1 shows COM1 at 3F8h and LPT1 at 378h.
